change: Space variants ('RNA seq', 'multi omics') were added to all queries and the search was re-run; this execution replaced the first one before screening.
dependent_results_and_labelling: All search results; reported as the baseline round.

change: First top-up round across all sources; two models were added to the list of models that the search must find; short abstracts were enriched through Crossref title search.
Criterion-by-criterion screening with three prompt roles (scope reviewer, architecture reviewer, adjudicator) was adopted; the final decision is derived by fixed rules, not emitted by the model.
Second top-up round with the same queries and only the date limits changed.
Third top-up round with the same queries and only the date limits changed.
Full-text screening was done on the reconstructed data-source and input-representation sections of each paper, screened with the title and abstract.
A human resolution layer was added: the review lead inspected the cited full sections of the records left uncertain by automated full-text screening; the automated decisions were kept alongside.
dependent_results_and_labelling: Inclusion decisions for the records left uncertain; the automated decisions are kept for audit.

change: A resumable procedure for living updates was added, from the dated search to publication of the updated atlas.
Fifth round (living update): OpenAlex was added, and Google Scholar was queried with one combined query through a provider export.
OpenAlex was added to abstract enrichment, so that no record of the August round is excluded for lack of an abstract.
Input routes were charted as grounded routes from source object to carrier and classified in an input-representation taxonomy; the protocol's extraction plan did not foresee this.
Each input path was decomposed into calls to a library of reusable data operations, with a three-run consensus and a parameter pass that records whether each parameter is stated.
dependent_results_and_labelling: Operation reuse, unexpanded steps, unstated parameters, archetypes and opaque-step shares.

change: The decomposition rules were revised after run-to-run disagreement, sharpening the boundaries between align, concatenate and serialise, and between partition and select; the affected papers were decomposed and their parameter pass repeated.
dependent_results_and_labelling: All decomposition results; the stability on the papers that informed the revision is reported as in-sample (Supplementary Note S3).

change: The decomposition used gpt-5.6-luna instead of gpt-5.4-mini, which is no longer available through Codex.
dependent_results_and_labelling: Decomposition, parameter pass and targeted charting.

change: Motifs (recurring operation sub-chains) and five design axes with archetypes were defined after inspecting the decomposed data.
dependent_results_and_labelling: Motif and archetype results; the axes are described as not validated on an independent corpus (Limitations).

change: An earlier comparison of exact route chains, which reported no recurring recipes, was withdrawn as an artefact of chain construction and replaced by the motif analysis.
dependent_results_and_labelling: None; the earlier result is not reported.

change: The design-culture analysis and a targeted charting pass (rationales, supervision, dependence tests, cross-representation comparisons) were defined after exploring the decomposed corpus.
dependent_results_and_labelling: All culture-level results; described as exploratory (Methods, Results and figure legends), with contrasts not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

change: An error in the automated keyword check that precedes screening was corrected, which recovered one eligible record (XunZi); it was screened with the same frozen procedures.
dependent_results_and_labelling: Counted among the included records and shown in the flow diagram.

change: A 13-day gap between the baseline and first top-up windows was checked by re-running the baseline queries of four sources for the gap (2026-10-14); no eligible record was found.
An audit found that the abstract shown with the selected sections was cut for some records and that some reports were not screened at full text; the screening was not repeated.
